Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Business Assistant – Research & Development position at ADECCO Onsite P&G BIC in Strombeek-Bever. Although my background is in digital marketing and web development, I have developed strong organisational and administrative skills that are directly transferable to this role. I thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy supporting teams and take pride in keeping operations running smoothly.

In my current freelance and remote roles, I manage multiple projects simultaneously, from building and maintaining websites to coordinating content and tracking performance. I regularly use MS Office, particularly Excel, and have experience with various digital platforms and data sources. I am comfortable learning new systems quickly and have a proactive approach to problem-solving. For example, I use AI tools daily to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency, which aligns with the role's emphasis on process improvement and digital skills.

Moreover, I have experience handling confidential information responsibly, communicating clearly with clients and team members, and documenting processes accurately. My work on client websites and internal tools has taught me to manage priorities, meet deadlines and adapt to changing requirements. I am eager to bring this hands-on, detail-oriented mindset to the R&D department and contribute to a collaborative, international team.

I am fluent in English and motivated to grow within a company that values initiative and continuous learning. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can support the smooth operation of your R&D teams.

Kind regards,

cv_highlights:
• Proactive and organised: manages multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously as a freelancer and remote digital marketer.

• Experience with data management and documentation: maintains websites, databases and content, ensuring accuracy and up-to-date information.
• Clear communicator and team player: collaborates with clients and colleagues, handles confidential information responsibly.
• Process-oriented mindset: uses AI and automation to simplify workflows and improve efficiency, with a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
